title: Rendering an SVG link fails after an HTML link with href exists
expected_behavior: Clicking "Render SVG icon link" must render the SVG <a> element with href="#top" and show the success status, even though an HTML <a href> link was created earlier on the page. HTML links, inputs and other elements must keep working.
independent_check_author: Adapted by the ReproPatch operator from the upstream VanJS tests added in the fix commit (MIT); not run by maintainers

title: vanX.compact export loses each Point object's own format
expected_behavior: After deleting a point, "Export points (vanX.compact)" must output each remaining Point in its own toJSON format, e.g. ["1,2","3,4"], with holes removed; plain objects and arrays must compact as before.
independent_check_author: Adapted by the ReproPatch operator from the upstream VanJS tests added in the fix commit (MIT); not run by maintainers

title: VanX list keeps stale rows after the array is shortened
expected_behavior: After the shopping list array is shortened (for example "Keep first 2" sets items.length = 2, or "Clear list" sets it to 0), the rendered list must show exactly the remaining items, keep the surviving rows, and remove the dropped rows from the page.
